summary: Read-only audit of the Reemtsma production report and dashboard estate. Estate health score 29/100 (red). 1,470 reports and 83 dashboards; 885 reports (60.2%) are cleanup candidates and 22 of 83 dashboards run as an inactive user and therefore serve stale data. Source control coverage is 0.3%. Event Monitoring, ReportSubscription and AnalyticSnapshot were unavailable, so confidence is degraded and the quarantine step is mandatory.
key_findings: 820 reports (55.8%) unused with no inbound reference; 65 never run at all
22 of 83 dashboards (26.5%) have an inactive running user and do not refresh - serving stale data
Source control coverage 0.3% (4 of 1,553 assets) - analytics layer exists only in production
925 reports (62.9%) not run in over a year; 567 not run in over two years; oldest run July 2015
Public Reports catch-all folder holds 176 unused reports; 22 empty report folders
21 duplicate-name clusters covering 47 reports; 42 reports carry copy artefacts in the name
Estate grows ~250-300 reports per year with no retirement process
confidence_caveats: Event Monitoring (ReportEvent/DashboardEvent) unavailable - no Shield licence
ReportSubscription not queryable - subscribed reports cannot be identified
AnalyticSnapshot not queryable - snapshot source reports cannot be identified
Dashboard usage is inferred, not measured; no dashboard proposed for deletion
180-day threshold may misclassify annual reports in FY folders
org_changes_made: none - read-only audit; only SELECT queries were issued. No report, dashboard, folder or subscription was deleted, moved or modified. The cleanup CSV is a proposal for human execution.
output: Full report at org_assessment/2026-08-11-reports-dashboards-review.md with executive summary and estate health score, explicit confidence-level section, age profile, unused report analysis by folder, never-used breakdown by creator, dashboard ownership findings, folder health, duplicates, source control gap, a 6-wave decommission plan gated on a mandatory metadata retrieval, a governance plan with owners per rule, next steps, and an appendix of 7 verification gaps. Cleanup candidates exported to org_assessment/2026-08-11-reports-dashboards-cleanup.csv (907 rows).
